body:
Ported SHANKPIT's food_items.h data table verbatim (bigo_food_items.h). Forked item_drop_mod.prn/inventory_mod.prn into PARENA/stdlib/big_o/ (not a shared PAPERCRAFT edit) so WOOD-material destruction drops one of 17 real food items (object-index mod 17, deterministic) and food items get a real 20-stack cap, reusing the existing GTA3-style drop+pickup pipeline unchanged. Re-investigated the §12 health blocker and found it bigger than scoped: no player damage source exists anywhere in BIG_O, so eat-to-heal is named and deferred honestly rather than faked. bazel test //... 36/36 green (3 new real tests incl. a scratch #include-main.c harness proving the real drop+pickup path end to end), ASan/UBSan clean, live server binary re-verified. NORTHSTAR.md §16, CHANGELOG.md updated.

⚓ ☃
title: SECTION 536 reverse-port phase 5: 17-item food/cargo system (real cargo, no heal yet)
